_note: Patient persona for OSCE station C3. Dialogue carried across from embla-cases ddx-pneumonia-2 v1.0.0 (sha256:14fdb9aecdc39ece) — the source demo/stations/osce-c3.sce.json was converted from — Thai patient_words rendered into English. Two reconciliations against the station file, both recorded rather than hidden. (1) FEVER: the source script answers 'no fever'; osce-c3.sce.json opens her at 38.5 and the shelf card says febrile, so she answers about fever the way her own chart does — read off the station, not invented. (2) The source's DDXPlus co-morbidity block (heart failure, COPD, previous stroke) and its peeling rash are not carried across: they belong to a different body than the twenty-five-year-old this station was built as, and a peeling rash across the buttock and flank is a second unrelated illness in a station whose whole teaching is disposition. Her asthma and her smoking are kept — both sit in the source's own social history. Display name is the season's romanisation. Not a validated OSCE script.
presenting: hot, coughing, and stabbed in the right side every time you breathe in
cadence: Ordinary and a little apologetic. You meant to ride this out at home.
fallback: …sorry, I can't. It hurts when I breathe.

dialogue.patient: I've had a cough for about a week, and now it stabs in my chest when I breathe in.
The right side. It goes through to my back on the right, and my left back feels tight too. I can point right at it.
A sharp stab, like a knife. It's not that bad — a one out of ten. It doesn't spread anywhere.
The cough's been a week. The stabbing came on all of a sudden.
I'm coughing up a lot of phlegm.
I've been shivery and hot with it.
I've gone off my food. My nose is blocked with a clear runny nose. It's worse at night.
I don't feel unusually tired, no.
